questions.subject: english
questions.text: By the time we arrived at the cinema, the film ___ for twenty minutes.
questions.explanation: Действие длилось до определённого момента в прошлом («к моменту, когда мы пришли») — Past Perfect Continuous. Present Perfect Continuous связан с настоящим и здесь не подходит.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: If I ___ harder when I was at school, I would have a better job now.
questions.explanation: Смешанное условное: условие в прошлом (when I was at school) → Past Perfect, результат в настоящем (now) → would + V. «studied» означало бы нереальное условие в настоящем.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: Hardly ___ the station when the train left.
questions.explanation: После отрицательных наречий в начале предложения (Hardly, Scarcely, No sooner) нужна инверсия. Конструкция Hardly … when требует Past Perfect: Hardly had we reached …

questions.subject: english
questions.text: She is used to ___ up early, so the new timetable doesn't bother her.
questions.explanation: be used to + -ing — «иметь привычку, привыкнуть к чему-либо». Не путать с used to + V («раньше, бывало»): She used to get up early.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: I'd rather you ___ smoke in here.
questions.explanation: I'd rather + другое подлежащее + прошедшее время (сослагательное значение): I'd rather you didn't smoke. Если подлежащее то же самое — инфинитив без to: I'd rather not smoke.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: Don't worry, the report ___ by the time the manager comes back.
questions.explanation: Отчёт сам не заканчивает — нужен пассив. Действие завершится к моменту в будущем (by the time) — Future Perfect Passive: will have been + V3.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: Neither the teacher nor the students ___ aware of the change in the timetable.
questions.explanation: В конструкции neither … nor глагол согласуется с ближайшим подлежащим: the students — множественное число, поэтому were.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: It's high time we ___ home — it's already midnight.
questions.explanation: После It's (high) time + подлежащее используется Past Simple в значении «давно пора»: It's high time we went.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: He denied ___ the window, but everybody knew it was him.
questions.explanation: После deny используется герундий (deny doing / deny having done), а не инфинитив. Перфектный герундий подчёркивает, что действие было раньше отрицания.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: Not only ___ the exam, but she also got the highest score in the class.
questions.explanation: Not only в начале предложения требует инверсии, как в вопросе: вспомогательный глагол перед подлежащим — did she pass.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: You ___ have seen him in Dushanbe yesterday — he was in Paris then.
questions.explanation: Уверенность в том, что чего-то не было в прошлом: can't/couldn't + have + V3 («не может быть, чтобы ты его видел»). mustn't have — неправильная форма для этого значения.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: The more you practise, ___ you become.
questions.explanation: Конструкция «чем …, тем …»: The + сравнительная степень …, the + сравнительная степень … (The more you practise, the more confident you become).

questions.subject: english
questions.text: I wish I ___ that to her yesterday. Now she won't talk to me.
questions.explanation: Сожаление о прошлом: I wish + Past Perfect. I wish + Past Simple — сожаление о настоящем.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: She said, "I will call you tomorrow." In reported speech this becomes:
options: She said she will call me tomorrow.
She said she would call me the next day.
She said she would call you tomorrow.
She said she called me the next day.
questions.explanation: При согласовании времён will → would, you → me (говорят мне), tomorrow → the next day.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: This is the house ___ my grandfather was born.
questions.explanation: Придаточное обозначает место («в котором») — where = in which. «which»/«that» потребовали бы предлога: the house which my grandfather was born in.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: Each of the students ___ given a certificate at the end of the course.
questions.explanation: Each (of …) требует глагола в единственном числе: Each of the students was given …

questions.subject: english
questions.text: Please ___ this form and hand it to the secretary.
questions.explanation: fill in (a form) — «заполнить (анкету, бланк)». В американском варианте также fill out.

questions.text: Choose the word closest in meaning to "reluctant": He was reluctant to answer the question.
questions.explanation: reluctant — «неохотный, делающий что-то нехотя» = unwilling. eager — наоборот, «стремящийся».

questions.text: Don't worry if you ___ a mistake — everybody does.
questions.explanation: Устойчивое сочетание make a mistake. С do употребляются homework, exercises, a favour, one's best.

questions.explanation: put off — «отложить, перенести на более поздний срок». Отменить — call off или cancel.

questions.subject: english

questions.explanation: После артикля the и перед of нужно существительное со значением процесса — construction (строительство). constructor — «строитель, конструктор» (лицо), constructive — прилагательное.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: The actual price was much higher than we expected. "Actual" means
questions.explanation: «Ложный друг переводчика»: actual — «фактический, действительный», а не «актуальный» (актуальный — topical, current).

questions.subject: english
questions.text: My cousin is fluent ___ three languages.
questions.explanation: Устойчивое сочетание fluent in (a language) — «свободно владеющий языком».

questions.subject: english
questions.text: Choose the correctly spelled word.
questions.explanation: Правильно: necessary — одна c и две s (правило-подсказка: one Collar, two Sleeves).

questions.subject: english
questions.text: We were late because there was ___ on the way to the airport.
questions.explanation: Устойчивое сочетание: heavy traffic — «интенсивное движение, пробки». strong/big traffic не используются.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: The lecture was so ___ that half of the audience fell asleep.
questions.explanation: Прилагательные на -ing описывают то, что вызывает чувство (boring lecture — скучная лекция), на -ed — состояние человека (bored students — скучающие студенты).

questions.subject: english
questions.text: What is TRUE about Alexei Fedchenko?
options: He explored the Pamirs in the 1930s.
He never saw the glacier that was named after him.
He built a weather station on the glacier.
questions.explanation: В тексте: «named after … Alexei Fedchenko, who explored Central Asia in the 1870s, although he never actually saw the glacier himself». Карту составила экспедиция 1928 года, станцию построили в 1933 году.
questions.passage:
The Fedchenko Glacier in the Pamir Mountains of Tajikistan is one of the longest glaciers in the world outside the polar regions. It stretches for about 77 kilometres, and in places the ice is more than 900 metres thick. The glacier was named after the Russian naturalist Alexei Fedchenko, who explored Central Asia in the 1870s, although he never actually saw the glacier himself. It was first mapped in detail by an expedition in 1928.
In 1933 a weather station was built near the glacier at an altitude of more than 4,000 metres. For decades, the scientists who lived there measured temperature and snowfall and watched the movement of the ice. Their records show that, like most mountain glaciers, Fedchenko has been retreating: its lower end has moved back by about a kilometre, and the glacier has become thinner.
This matters far beyond the mountains. Meltwater from Pamir glaciers feeds rivers that millions of people downstream depend on for drinking water, farming and electricity. In the short term, faster melting can even increase the flow of rivers, but if the glaciers keep shrinking, there may eventually be much less water in the rivers during the dry summer months.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: What is the main idea of the text?
options: Students should study only in the evening.
Sleep plays an active role in learning and memory.
The brain switches off completely during sleep.
Afternoon naps are better than night sleep.
questions.explanation: Главная мысль: сон — не «выключение» мозга, а активный процесс, во время которого закрепляются знания. Первый неверный вариант — устаревшее мнение, которое автор опровергает.
questions.passage:
For a long time, sleep was seen as a passive state, a kind of 'switching off' of the brain. Research over the last few decades has shown that this is far from true. While we sleep, the brain is busy sorting the information collected during the day, strengthening some memories and letting others fade.
In one well-known type of experiment, volunteers learn a list of words or a new skill in the evening. Half of them then sleep normally, while the other half stay awake all night. When both groups are tested the next day, those who have slept usually remember considerably more. Interestingly, even a short afternoon nap can bring some benefit, although it cannot replace a full night's rest.
For students, the message is clear. Staying up all night before an exam may feel productive, but it often has the opposite effect: the material is poorly stored, and a tired brain finds it harder to concentrate and recall facts. Regular sleep, on the other hand, helps turn what we learn into lasting knowledge.

questions.subject: english
questions.text: Match the direct speech with the correct reported speech.
options: She asked me could I swim.

questions.explanation: Сдвиг времён: am → was, have finished → had finished, will → would, can → could. В косвенном общем вопросе используется if/whether и прямой порядок слов, поэтому «asked me could I swim» неверно.
